## Traceability Checklist
- [ ] PR links the correct feature spec in `docs/feat-*/FEATURE.md`
- [ ] PR links the implemented story file(s) in `docs/feat-*/stories/`
- [ ] PR body includes closing issue reference(s), for example `Closes #123`
- [ ] Any implementation change is reflected in documentation updates where needed
- [ ] Branch name follows the repo workflow (`doc/*` for docs, `feat/*` for implementation)
